Data

class robotdataprocess.data_types.Data.CoordinateFrame(value)

Bases: Enum

Enum for different coordinate frames used in robotics.

FLU

X forward, Y left, Z up := RHS

NED

X forward (north), Y right (east), Z down := RHS

ENU

X right (east), Y forward (north), Z up := RHS

NONE

No defined coordinate frame.

class robotdataprocess.data_types.Data.Data(frame_id: str, timestamps: np.ndarray | list)

Bases: object

Generic Data class that provides example methods that should be overwritten by children, and can run operations between different data types.

crop_data(start: Decimal, end: Decimal)

Will crop the data so only values within [start, end] inclusive are kept.
